decisions.choice: Add an optional { repo } second arg to makeProjector rather than using the {owner}/{repo} placeholder
decisions.justification: `gh issue view` needs a real -R value; the placeholder only works for `gh api` (projector.mjs:31-47). Optional keeps other callers unchanged.
